meaning:
ἐλλογάω, -ῶ
(a κοινή word, elsewhere usually -έω; cf. Bl., § 22, 2),
to charge to one's account, impute: Phm 18 (on parallels, cf. Deiss., LAE, 79 f., 335 f.; Milligan, NTD, 73; MM, Exp., xii); of sin, Rom.5:13 (Cremer, 400).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
